notes: The description names multiple terms without specifying RT versus errors. Extracted the focal posture × set-size interaction on response times from the specified pages; target_match remains null pending disambiguation. Authors separately describe an error-rate interaction that depends on classifying late responses as errors; its statistics are not combined with the extracted RT test. Success verdict is for the selected RT effect. Effect-size upper bound preserved as printed.
